text: Since I have begun with maxims of state, I will add another, namely, that a people may let a king fall, yet still remain a people; but, if a king let his people slip from him, he is no longer a king.
author: Abigail Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 102, Abigail Adams to John Adams, Braintree, 7 May, 1776
